newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares set fresh record as Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: French shares set fresh record as Wall Street rise.

text.p: French shares booked another all-time record in the afternoon on the back of a solid start on Wall Street, traders said.
* CAC-40 index up 48.35, or 1.6 percent, at 3,071.98 at 1408 GMT. All-time high set at 3.075,93.
* CAC-40 July futures 3,074 vs 3,025 at Tuesdays close.
* Volume was a heavy 8.4 billion francs
* Michelin down 3.58 percent at 385 francs. Rival Brigestone reported a slight increase in first half sales and increased its 1997 profit forecast.
